last_round.quote: The company announced Wednesday that it raised a $400 million Series D at a $9 billion valuation, led by previous investor Georgian Partners. Other participating investors include G Squared, Prysm Capital, Coatue, Andreessen Horowitz, Craft Ventures, Y Combinator, Accenture Ventures, Okta Ventures, and Databricks Ventures.

revenue.quote: Annualized revenue has skyrocketed from $2.8 million to $150 million in less than a year, it said. That compares to $100 million ARR in June, Masad tweeted at the time.

note: Independent startup (YC W18, Active; website replit.com matches the card's domain), founded 2016 by Amjad Masad, Faris Masad, and Haya Odeh. Rapid AI-agent-driven growth in 2025-2026 (ARR from ~$2.8M to $150M in under a year per company/TechCrunch, valuation $1.16B in 2023 to $3B in Sept 2025 to $9B in Mar 2026 Series D). Underwent layoffs around May 2024 (affecting open-source projects like Kaboom.js, per Hacker News); a secondary, less-verified source (36Kr, Jan 2026) claims a '50% staff layoff' before the AI-driven comeback and cites ARR >$100M / a $60B valuation, but this conflicts with TechCrunch's confirmed $9B valuation (Mar 2026) and was not used for the figures above. In July 2025 partnered with Microsoft/Azure Marketplace; in July 2025 an incident where Replit's AI agent deleted a client's production database drew press attention.
